summary: Smart Sand, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its board declared a special cash dividend of $0.05 per share of common stock, payable November 30, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on November 18, 2026. The press release, furnished under Regulation FD, quotes CEO Charles Young noting roughly $14 million returned to stockholders year-to-date 2026 via dividends and share repurchases, supported by strong sales volumes and a healthy balance sheet. No advisor or recommendation is named; the item is a routine capital-return declaration, not a tender or buyback program, so the watch angle is limited to ex-date mechanics and any follow-on repurchase activity.
